text:
claire: Pushing a focused PR that consolidates migration steps for v1->v2, plus an appendix for embedding dim changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912

josh: I'll review the TS + node streaming examples. Noted mismatch: v1 used newline-delimited JSON; v2 SDK uses async iterator. I'll add a side-by-side and a tiny helper `assembleJsonStream()` utility.

mina: I'll own the embed reindex appendix. Plan: include a sample batch script and a back-of-envelope cost estimate for 100k items.

claire: Thanks. Mina, can you also add a short declarative checklist customers can follow (reindex? repin models? update SDK?).

mina: Yup. Draft checklist: 1) run `reindex.sh --batch 500` 2) pin model versions in prod 3) run docs-smoke examples locally 4) update deps.

liz: Add dates to PR description: announce 2026-05-01, migrate by 2026-08-01, shutdown 2026-09-01. Marketing asked for that exact timeline.

josh: Small code example I'll include for iterator pattern:
```
for await (const part of client.streamGenerate(req)) {
  buffer.push(part.text)
}
const full = buffer.join('')
```
I'll add note on framing when `framing: json` is set.

mina: Reindex pseudo: `python reindex.py --src old-emb --dst new-emb --batch 1000`. Estimate: ~ $10 per 100k on dedicated. Marked as estimate.

claire: Can someone add a CI smoke check that runs the top 3 snippets? Prefer it as GH Action `docs-smoke` that posts status on the PR.

ci-bot: docs-smoke job created in branch docs/migration-912.

liz: Make sure to add `owner:` labels in the PR per docs-bot checklist. Also include a short customer-facing blurb for the banner.

mina: Draft banner: "We will retire the v1 API on Sep 1, 2026. Please migrate to v2 by Aug 1, 2026 to avoid service disruption."

josh: Suggest adding a link to the migration checklist in parentheses.

claire: Action items: josh (TS snippets + streaming helper), mina (reindex appendix + checklist), liz (final sign-off), claire (merge once CI green).

docs-bot: Reminder: add changelog entry under `docs/changes/2026-04-05.md`.

claire: I'll add the changelog. If CI green, plan to merge after 48h review. :shipit:
